items.name: pace of every narration beat

items.name: every voice clip is a verified one
items.threshold: every clip has its .ok mark, made before the build, and is inside the pace bounds of C1; no beat fails C1; every beat is as long as its cached clips (within 0.06 s). items.name: the sound follows the beat timeline
